no_rule_findings.finding: This 2024 council motion only asks the Los Angeles Housing Department to report on algorithmic rent-setting software and on the feasibility of a ban. It is not a rule, so it shows no enacted ban at this point.
no_rule_findings.basis_citation: L.A. City Council Motion, File No. 24-1031 (Hutt, Sept. 3, 2024)
no_rule_findings.quoted_span: report on the number of ownership and management entities that are using algorithm-based software to establish rents and the feasibility of instituting a ban on the use of this software to set rents in the City.

parsed.doc_summary: A September 2024 Los Angeles City Council motion (Councilmember Hutt, File 24-1031). It directs LAHD to report on algorithm-based rent-setting software such as RealPage and on the feasibility of a ban. It creates no binding rule, so there are no rule records. It supports a no-rule finding for algorithmic rent setting.
